surprises.description: Q3 revenue was $13.2 million, far above the preview’s $4.51 million consensus and its $2–4 million model, despite the preview expecting little revenue from the remaining GSK collaboration. The reported revenue was driven entirely by GSK.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Q3 2026 revenue rose to $13.2 million … driven entirely by the GSK collaboration.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: “Revenue: $4.51M” consensus; the preview also said, “I model $2–4M.”

surprises.description: GSK selected an siRNA development candidate, triggering a $12 million milestone due in Q4, while three other programs continue toward candidate selection. The preview discussed the live GSK collaboration but did not anticipate a candidate selection or this milestone.
surprises.fact_evidence: “GSK selected an siRNA development candidate during the quarter, triggering a $12 million milestone payment due in Q4, with 3 additional GSK programs still advancing toward candidate selection.”

surprises.description: Wave gave a Q4 2026 timing expectation for WVE-007 600-milligram Phase I single-dose data on potency, duration, and safety. The preview focused on the timing of Phase 2a data and did not flag this specific Phase I update.
surprises.fact_evidence: “WVE-007 600-milligram Phase I single-dose data (potency, duration, safety) is expected in Q4 2026.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview said management had “not committed to a data-release date” for the Phase 2a trials and identified a firm Phase 2a date as a key upside possibility.

surprises.description: Management said the Phase IIa monotherapy participants have substantially higher baseline adiposity than Phase I participants and expressed confidence that this supports crossing the 5% weight-loss threshold at 12 months. The preview noted the BMI 35–50 enrollment but did not report this rationale or confidence.
surprises.fact_evidence: “The Phase IIa monotherapy trial for WVE-007 is enrolling patients with BMI 35-50 and comorbidities whose baseline adiposity is substantially higher than Phase I, supporting management's confidence in crossing the 5% weight-loss regulatory threshold at 12 months.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview said Phase 2a monotherapy dosing was underway in “BMI 35–50, ± T2D,” and highlighted the weak Phase I weight-loss result as part of the debate.

surprises.description: The FDA accepted Wave’s validated assay for measuring M-AAT and Z-AAT across the WVE-006 program, a favorable regulatory-development update not anticipated in the preview.
surprises.fact_evidence: “The FDA accepted Wave's validated LCMS assay to measure M-AAT and Z-AAT proteins across the WVE-006 development program.”

surprises.description: Wave plans to start a WVE-007 post-incretin maintenance trial in Q4 2026, an additional trial plan not identified in the preview’s discussion of the ongoing monotherapy and tirzepatide combination Phase 2a trials.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Wave plans to initiate the WVE-007 post-incretin maintenance trial in Q4 2026.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview described the WVE-007 monotherapy and tirzepatide combination Phase 2a trials, but did not mention a post-incretin maintenance trial.

surprises.description: R&D and G&A spending both exceeded the preview’s estimated ranges: R&D was $53.8 million versus $48–52 million, and G&A was $25.4 million versus $22–24 million.
surprises.fact_evidence: “R&D expenses grew to $53.8 million and G&A rose to $25.4 million.”

surprises.description: Cash and marketable securities ended the quarter at $431 million, below the preview’s estimated $435–455 million range. The company nevertheless retained the expected runway into Q3 2028.
surprises.fact_evidence: “The company ended the quarter with $431 million in cash and marketable securities, expected to fund operations into Q3 2028.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview estimated “Cash & marketable sec. | ~$435–455M” and expected runway language “into Q3 2028.”

surprises.description: Despite the higher-than-estimated R&D and G&A expenses, the $61.9 million net loss was below the preview’s modeled $64–67 million loss. That is a modestly better result than the preview’s loss estimate.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Net loss widened to $61.9 million in Q3 2026.”
